name: Schnitt 5.9.1
notes:
# Schnitt 5.9.1

This is a performance and storage release. Project files, effects and exported videos keep their existing formats.

## Less memory while editing

Waveforms now keep only the sixteen most recent audio tracks in memory. Font typefaces keep the twenty-four most recently used faces, and web image search results keep a small rolling window. Thumbnail bitmaps are released as soon as the editor goes to the background, and Android low-memory callbacks now clear the same caches immediately.

The effect catalog is parsed once per language instead of being rebuilt for every preview, preset sheet and project preview. Imported effects still appear immediately.

## Less storage used by caches

Preview copies of large videos now have a 1 GB budget instead of 2 GB. Abandoned preview copies, partial files and failed jobs older than thirty days are removed on the daily clean-up. Downloadable Google fonts keep the most recent 64 MB, old cache files are removed after fourteen days, and waveform data is capped at 32 MB. Unused web image search downloads are cleaned with the rest of the project media.

## Native reader note

The Aurea tree in the aur folder contains a proprietary native After Effects reader inside libaurea.so. Its code and assets are not open source, so Schnitt does not embed that library; the existing independent importers remain in use.

## Under the hood

The daily clean-up now budgets cache, previews, fonts, waveforms and web image downloads separately. Nothing in project folders, exported videos or imported fonts is touched.
